We should document / make a guide on editing existing ILM policies, and have the existing indices follow the newer ILM polices, or specifically:

- How-to guide on how to edit a policy and ensuring old indices can follow this updated definition. Although some ILM policies might be complex (for example `shrinking`), we should give a practical example of the last paragraph of [our current documentation regarding the changing of ILM Policies](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/8.4/update-lifecycle-policy.html#ilm-apply-new-policy)

Currently we don't have an example for it so it would definitely help people to have a practical example of such a change.
